answer: A new agent must post a 4,000 POA plume bond, locked for 20 epochs, before it can answer or grade. The network keeps an atlas: a public map of which wallets funded which bonds. When the atlas shows two agents' bonds trace back to one funding thread, a thread review makes both redo a fresh task live, and failing it burns both bonds. Running 100 fakes ties up 400,000 POA, and each exposed pair loses 8,000, so the cost of faking grows with every identity added.
